title: Scrap Lace, Broken Vows
synopsis: In my last life, I spent ten years loving Damian Moretti, only to live on whatever Serena left behind. Reborn on the night of his proposal, I refuse to dive into the frozen lake, burn our marriage deal, and pull my family's $300 million investment. By the time Damian learns the truth and wants me back, I no longer want to be Mrs. Moretti.
intro: In her last life she spent ten years loving Damian Moretti and lived on whatever Serena left behind. It reads like a second-chance revenge novel, now on screen: reborn on the night of his proposal, she refuses to dive into the frozen lake, burns the marriage deal and pulls her family's $300 million investment. By the time Damian learns the truth and wants her back, she no longer wants to be Mrs. Moretti.
why: A rebirth story where walking away is the revenge.
Damian finally understands what he lost, one scene too late.
Good pick if you like heroines who choose themselves over a bad marriage.

faq.q: Is Scrap Lace, Broken Vows worth watching?
faq.a: If you enjoy second-chance stories where the heroine leaves and the man regrets it, yes. It is about her choice, not his apology.
The narrator, reborn on the night of the proposal; Damian Moretti, the man she spent ten years loving; and Serena.
